algorithm: NPG (DAPG-style experts), TorchRL RL baselines, BC on R3M/RRL/VC1 visual features
hand: Adroit Hand (benchmarked results); framework also supports Shadow, Allegro, MPL, D'Hand, D'Manus, MyoHand
success_criterion: per-env 'solved' flag: door hinge angle > 1.35 rad; hammer target-goal distance < 0.010; pen rotation cosine > 0.95 and not dropped; relocate object-target distance < 0.1
human_data: RoboSet (Table 2): teleoperated and expert demonstrations across real kitchen, bin, Franka kitchen, Adroit, and D'Kitty
paper_code_mismatch: Hammer v1 code's 'lifted' bonus condition drops the tool-height term present in v0 (obj_pos z>0.04 * tool_pos z>0.04 becomes obj_pos>0.04 * obj_pos>0.04), a version-dependent reward change not mentioned in the paper.
note_gaps: No hand DoF, timestep, control rate, or observation dimension is stated in either source; visual-baseline bar-chart values are not recoverable from the parsed figures.
